notes.title: AURA: Patch v1.1 + Survey + 28% OFF Last Day!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161894/1198d9d3ca70a7e5ccd91dec41057629cfa7c2e9.jpg[/img]

[h3][i]Hey, our favorite Heroes of Pentarull![/i][/h3]
Thank you for buying [b]AURA: Hentai Cards[/b] and supporting us by purchasing our bonuses 💗 Today we have some important [b]NEWS[/b] for you!

[b]First news - Patch v1.1 is out[/b], in which we tweaked the balance of combat and character level, as well as [b]ADDED 4 NEW DIFFICULTY LEVELS[/b] 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161894/c800e22821df55aabff95509d41929bae473dc57.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Changelog v1.1:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added NEW difficulty levels (Easy, Normal, Hard, Nightmare, El Diablo). You will be able to select a difficulty level at the start of a new game
[*] Added a “Skip Dialogue” option (X button in the dialogue box)
[*] Adjusted game balance of characters in relation to the new difficulty system
[*] Weakened the "Murder in the Shadows" card. Now it does not kill in one hit, but takes away a third of the character's health. Also, the percentage of triggering the effect has been reduced to 5%.
[*] Weakened the card “Zombie Capture”. Now instead of skipping a turn, 2 to 4 cards are taken away from the opponent at the beginning of their turn.
[*] Weakened the shield mechanic. Now the maximum number of shields can not exceed 5 units. Also recalculated the number of shields in relation to the damage received.
[*] Added consolation rewards when losing a battle. The reward depends on the selected difficulty level
[*] Weakened the level-up system. There is a maximum level of the character to which you can go. Its value will depend on the difficulty level of the game
[*] Fixed minor visual bugs
[*] The achievement "The Hero of Steel!" has been reduced from 1000 to 500 XP
[*] Added 5 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS on Steam. One of them is SECRET!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161894/e5baf408d73b7116829024db71d1ccc7e0c6bfe2.png[/img]

[b]The second news[/b] is that we've created a survey where you can leave detailed feedback about our game, as well as answer various questions that we'll build on in the future. [i]For example: which characters to introduce in new DLC![/i]

[b][h3]Link to the Survey: [url=https://forms.gle/qKbZL9z8rR9a6bM57]https://forms.gle/qKbZL9z8rR9a6bM57[/url] 👍[/h3][/b]

[b]The third news[/b] - we are already creating [b]Trading Cards on Steam[/b], which will be released in November 🎴

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161894/709acc502208c39116ee66ecb56217b45ff79e58.jpg[/img]

[b]The last news[/b] for today is that the discount on our game will end tomorrow at 5PM London Time! So don't miss the opportunity to buy our game at a 15% OFF or the entire [u][b]DIVINE EDITION[/b][/u] bundle at an incredible [b]28% OFF[/b] 😎

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35513/AURA_Hentai_Cards__DIVINE_EDITION/


[b]We would love it if you leave a review of our game on Steam![/b] It's an incentive to improve our creation and get better. Love and happiness to everyone 💜 [i](and don't forget to complete our Survey)[/i]
